user.title: Water Treatment Monitor
user.description: Select a binary sensor that reports the pump's energized state. Optionally enter the timestamp of your FIRST reliably confirmed observation using ISO 8601 with UTC offset (for example, 2026-01-01T12:00:00-05:00). Earlier Recorder events will NOT be imported; leave blank only if all recoverable history is reliable. This integration never controls equipment.

data.import_start: Earliest reliable history (ISO 8601 with timezone; optional)

abort.already_configured: Water Treatment Monitor is already configured

error.invalid_timestamp: Enter ISO 8601 with a timezone, e.g. 2026-01-01T12:00:00-05:00

init.title: Existing pH helper button (optional)
init.description: Choose both helpers to make your existing Record pH button save a FINAL TREATED water measurement into the durable archive. Set the pH value first, then press the button. Leave BOTH blank to use only the Water Treatment dashboard form. The existing helper value may still be its default (4.0); verify it before recording.

error.both_ph_helpers_required: Select BOTH a pH button and a pH numeric value, or leave BOTH blank.
